title: Example page
lede: A custom page made of blocks. Duplicate this in the editor, or delete it once you have real ones.

blocks.heading: How this page exists
blocks.body:
It is one JSON file under content/pages/, created from the Custom pages collection in the editor.

To put a page like this in the nav, add a row on the Structure page with the page's filename as the id. This one is hidden, so it is only reachable by link.

1. Custom pages -> Add page -> write blocks -> Save
2. Structure -> Add section -> id = the page filename
3. Watch it appear in the nav and on the hydrograph
